description: nhflow_3d_amr_stairs with subcycling (G 7 1): the front of the column at the coarse-fine interface, along the faces and at the re-entrant corners. The coarse cells outside the patches take the pressure of the patches on the interface faces (sub_preg, sub_reflux), not only their fluxes; without it the velocity of those cells was off by 17 % of the largest velocity (the fluxes moved them, the coarse pressure of the covered cells did not hold them back). `ranks`: the final state within 10 % of the largest value of each field of nhflow_3d_amr_stairs (the same time step, one step for all levels; with it 7 %, before 17 %).
covers: nhflow_amr::sub_preg (coarse and fine side), the pressure in sub_reflux, Cartesian
